title: Русский павильон в Венеции: А. В. Щусев / Russian Pavilion in Venice: Alexei Shchusev (Garage, Moscow 2014)
contents: Centenary book: per the RAAN record it publishes 'in the fullest possible extent' Shchusev's graphic, photographic and documentary material on the pavilion (design drawings 1913-14) and his unknown pre-revolutionary exhibition-building projects; 144 unnumbered pages (CCA record via R2)
author: M. Evstratova (article, compiling editor), S. Koluzakov (compiling editor), D. Shvidkovsky (preface)
holder: Garage Museum of Contemporary Art (publisher); copy in Garage Library, Moscow (RAAN L33305, 'Available on request'); CCA Montreal 919487901
fetch_rule: print book, no digital copy online (RAAN shows the cover only, on hb.bizmrg.com, robots-closed)
evidence: RAAN record page fetched through the guard (200); description read
notes: Same book as R2 lead L4 (no R2 row). Main source for Shchusev's 1913-14 drawings besides MUAR and the Garage Shchusev archive.

title: ASAC Fondo storico, Architettura: national-participation and 'agibilità' files of the Russian pavilion with plans, 2000-2012
contents: Archive units naming plans of the Russia pavilion: b. 291/5 (Architettura 2000, Paesi con padiglione R-S: 'schede tecniche, planimetrie', Russia), b. 305 (2000 Ufficio Tecnico: files of the foreign pavilions for the certificate of occupancy, Russia), b. 342 (2002 agibilità O-Z: 'relazioni tecnico-illustrative e planimetrie', Russia), b. 416/4 (2006 Paesi con padiglione P-V: 'piante', Russia), b. 423/18 (2006 agibilità G-V: 'planimetrie', Russia), b. 437 (2008 agibilità I-V: 'piante', Russia), b. 458 (2010 agibilità R: 'piante, relazioni tecniche', Russia), b. 468 (2012 richieste: 'installazioni esterne, progetti, piante', Russia), b. 470 (2012 agibilità R-V: 'piante', Russia)
author: commissioners of the Russian pavilion / technical consultants (not stated)
holder: La Biennale di Venezia, ASAC (Archivio Storico delle Arti Contemporanee), Fondo storico, serie Architettura
fetch_rule: archive boxes, consultation by appointment (consultazione.asac@labiennale.org); the inventory PDF is the only online part
evidence: Inventory PDF fetched by R3 (guard 200, _work/guard/pages/asac.labiennale.org/26049e0f_04-Architettura.pdf); text grepped by R102 (peek.py pdf-text + pymupdf): unit descriptions quoted
notes: Occupancy ('agibilità') files usually hold survey floor plans of each pavilion with exits and installations: the best archive route to plans of the Russian pavilion in its 2000-2012 states. Not in R2 (R2 grepped only 04-Scatole_nere_padiglioni, 04-Paesi, 05-Lavori). leads.md L1.
